caveats: One-off exploration, not a governed saved metric; data_catalog scope unavailable.
Regular is PostHog traffic classification, not proof that every visitor is human.
Funnel counts are ordered unique-person funnels with a one-day conversion window.

Signup shown/start/submitted instrumentation is incomplete across surfaces and first appears October 19 in the queried window. Do not infer an overall signup conversion rate from the full-month step totals.
Signup endpoint returns {ok:true} for blocked submissions; clients emit email_signup_completed on ok:true. This is not proof a subscriber record was saved.
Connected Supabase account does not list 9takes, so saved subscriber counts were not verified.
Retention uses UTC calendar weeks; only mature cohorts should be interpreted. Do not interpret recent cohort zeros as churn.
Registration server event lacks $host. Domain-filtered queries omit it; project-wide count was 1.
